Change: one commit "R1 248: Organization.ts keeps wiring; …" touching `packages/cloudflare/src/Organization.ts` and new `packages/cloudflare/src/organization/{Scheduling,RoundJobs,RoundCommands,TestSupport}.ts`. Issue #248 ("Fixes #248"). Verification already run: fence gate (typecheck, lint, format, ledgers, 1210 unit, 241 privacy), adapter tests Organization.test.ts 14/14, EmailOutbox.test.ts 4/4, Email.test.ts 1/1, and an independent review that diffed moved bodies against the original.

PR title: `R1 248: split Organization.ts into scheduling, Round jobs, Round commands and test-support slices`
PR body (use exactly):

## Why
`Organization.ts` was 1,610 lines. The other `organization/*.ts` slices already take a deps record and return RPCs, but the Round lifecycle, the largest and riskiest part, never moved. Splitting it first makes #249 (a pure `decideRoundCommand`), #244 and #247 smaller. Fixes #248.

## What changed
A mechanical move, no behaviour change: same RPC names and signatures, same SQL, transaction boundaries and effect order.
- `organization/Scheduling.ts` (143 lines): `scheduleNextRound`, `updateScheduledRoundForPulse`, `activeMembersWithTimeZones`.
- `organization/RoundJobs.ts` (884): the seven job executors, payload parsing, `runDueJobs`. One module, since close → compute → share call each other. The `injectedComputeFailures` map stays per instance.
- `organization/RoundCommands.ts` (346): `runRoundCommand`, verbatim. Its logic moves to the domain in #249.
- `organization/TestSupport.ts` (133): the 17 RPCs only tests and test-stage routes call, so the user-reachable surface reads in one place.
- `Organization.ts` is 316 lines of wiring, `repairAlarm`, `alarm`, the test-send helper, production RPCs and spreads.

## Verification
Fence gate: typecheck, lint, format, ledgers, 1210 unit, 241 privacy tests. Adapter tests on local workerd: `Organization.test.ts` 14/14, `organization/EmailOutbox.test.ts` 4/4, `Email.test.ts` 1/1. A review diffed each moved body against the original: only one oxfmt re-wrap and call-site renames.

## Not covered
Six test-support RPCs have no caller at all (`recomputeResult`, `getInvitationByTokenHash`, `isOptedOut`, `getPersonTimeZone`, `recordParticipation`, `hasAnswered`). Kept so this PR stays a pure move; delete in a follow-up.

Return the PR URL and head SHA.
